description: Defines UI component classes for system console settings in Playwright tests, including radio buttons, text inputs, dropdowns, and collapsible panels.

classes.name: RadioSetting
classes.description: Represents a true/false radio button group with methods to select options and verify state.

classes.name: TextInputSetting
classes.description: Represents a text input field with methods to fill, retrieve, and clear the input.

classes.name: DropdownSetting
classes.description: Represents a dropdown select element with methods to select options and verify selection.

classes.name: AdminSectionPanel
classes.description: Represents a collapsible admin section panel with visibility check.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the component is visible.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the text input with a specified value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the text input.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects an option in the dropdown.

methods.name: getSelectedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected value in the dropdown.

methods.name: AdminSectionPanel
methods.description: Constructor for the admin section panel component.
